result.summary: The environment features wide, well-maintained sidewalks and natural traffic calming provided by a cobblestone roadway. However, the lack of marked crosswalks at the stop-controlled intersection and the uneven road surface present accessibility and safety challenges for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Uneven Road Surface
hazards.description: The cobblestone roadway is uneven, creating a trip hazard and making crossing difficult for those with mobility aids or strollers.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: Despite the presence of stop signs, there are no painted crosswalks to designate pedestrian priority or space.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the middle ground

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A parked minivan on the right side of the street partially obscures the sightline between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Ensure all crossing points have detectable warning surfaces and appropriate slopes for accessibility.

result.summary: The image depicts a high-quality pedestrian environment with a wide, well-maintained concrete sidewalk and a cobblestone roadway that provides natural traffic calming. While the walkway is spacious and clear of obstructions, there is a lack of a continuous physical buffer or street lighting visible in the immediate area.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no continuous physical barrier or furniture zone separating the wide sidewalk from the cobblestone roadway, potentially exposing pedestrians to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line between the sidewalk and the street.

interventions.title: Install Street Furniture or Bollards
interventions.description: Adding benches, planters, or bollards in the space between the trees would create a more robust physical and psychological buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street-level lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

result.summary: The street features a cobblestone surface that naturally limits vehicle speeds, flanked by wide and well-maintained sidewalks. While the environment is generally pedestrian-friendly with good separation from traffic, there are no marked mid-block crossings connecting the large office building to the adjacent park area.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: There is no designated or marked crossing point for pedestrians wishing to move between the office building and the park.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the cobblestone roadway

hazards.name: Uneven road surface
hazards.description: The cobblestone pavement, while serving as traffic calming, presents a potential tripping hazard or barrier for those with mobility aids if they need to cross the street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint to designate a safe crossing point between the building and the park.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at a new crossing point to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, well-maintained brick pedestrian plaza adjacent to a cobblestone street. The environment is highly separated from vehicular traffic, and the cobblestone surface serves as a natural traffic calming measure, though formal crossing infrastructure is not visible in the immediate foreground.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: There is no clearly marked pedestrian crossing connecting the cobblestone street to the large brick plaza area.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, transition between cobblestone and brick.

hazards.name: Potential trip hazard
hazards.description: The transition from the uneven cobblestone street to the raised curb and brick plaza may present a tripping hazard for some users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a continental-style marked crosswalk to clearly define the pedestrian path across the cobblestone street.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped curb ramps to ensure the plaza is accessible to all users.
